episodes.instruction: Grab the dark mug with a curved handle on the table, rotate it, set it down in the middle, then hang it onto the dark gray rack with flat back.
Grab the cylindrical mug with handle from the table, rotate it, and set it in the center. Then hang the cylindrical mug with handle on the rack with straight and slanted rods.
Lift the mug with rounded bottom and handle from the table, spin it, set it down, and hang it on the medium-sized rack.
